rationale: Tests ability to apply triple assessment principle to an age-appropriate breast investigation scenario
Reinforces the principle that triple assessment requires all three components — no single test is sufficient
Tests differentiation between common benign breast conditions based on clinical features
Tests understanding of sentinel lymph node biopsy as the standard axillary staging procedure
Tests counselling knowledge about treatment choice and key information patients need for informed consent
Tests knowledge of the correct systematic approach to breast palpation including axillary examination
